verdict.rationale: uv is operated only through structured CLI subcommands and flags (`uv init`, `uv add`, `uvx`, and so on); the evidence shows no built-in natural-language interface or assistant. A developer tool could plausibly ship such an interface, so the axis applies. The llms.txt documentation index helps external LLMs read the docs, but that is an adjacent building block, not natural-language operation of uv itself.
